parts.name: Hinge
parts.Basic_description: This is a hinge of the door set made of steel, typically small in size and attached to the door and frame to allow rotation.
parts.Functional_description: It connects the door to the frame and allows the door to pivot open and closed smoothly.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its pin axis to enable the door’s swinging motion.

parts.name: Hinge
parts.Basic_description: This is another hinge of the door set, also made of steel, positioned to support the door’s weight and ensure balanced movement.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional support and stability to the door, distributing the load evenly between hinges.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis in coordination with the other hinge to allow the door to swing open or closed.

parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the main door panel made of wood, rectangular in shape, and forms the primary barrier or entryway.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main movable barrier that opens and closes to allow or restrict access through an entryway.
parts.Movement_description: It swings about the hinges to open or close, rotating around the hinge axis.
